title: Oregon Army National Guard Blackhawks Assist Emergency Responders at Dollar Lake Fire
description: B-roll of how Oregon Army National Guard Blackhawks assist emergency responders at Dollar Lake fire.  Scenes include Soldiers with C/7-158 Aviation, Oregon Army National Guard, setting up a helicopter water bucket, UH-60 Blackhawk in flight picking up water, dumping water on the fire, landing at base operations. Produced by Sgt. Jason Van Mourik - Oregon Military Dept. Public Affairs, Mount Hood, Ore.  Also available in High Definition.
